subject: The LIVE dispatcher (live-execution/), its seven registered roles and the sealed root they bind (charter DL5: an independent review of the dispatcher before first use).
basis: Rounds pre-seal-1 and pre-seal-2 are seeded from the fix commits' messages and the charter handoff notes (git log 98dfef53a..89e7b0d90). Reconcile each against the review reports before sealing the proof; a finding the reports carry and the commits do not must be added with its disposition.

severity.P0: blocks every exposure or corrupts a verdict
severity.P1: loses the one-shot read or admits a wrong verdict
severity.P2: a recoverable fault or race on a real path
severity.P3: hardening, documentation or a narrow edge

reviewers: opus read-only review: LIVE dispatcher with capture/native roles
opus read-only review: judge, targets, fit and measurement
opus read-only review: measurement/owner roles and root wiring

findings.summary: Owner referee read an absent L1 interior mean as not-null, so eight dark inactive dark-solid context cells graded UNMEASURED and every exposure would be NEITHER (DL5n owner-port recovery).
Owner config, Node closure and intrinsic inputs were first exercised after the exposure analysis marker; a metadata-only owner admission now runs before every marker.
Gate and exposure batches did not name the owner intrinsic records before any marker.
Draft root registered no owner runtime closure when it sat outside the repository.
A lease left by a dead holder wedged the phase; stale-lease release.
Capture source reconstruction was only compared with synthetic transports; conformance with the real CURRENT3 transports.
Native admit checked extracted members by name and stat only; it now hashes every frame before the marker.
PID reuse could read a dead claim as alive (ps lstart against the claim time).
Recovered payload path did not carry its reconciliation ordinal.
Stage contexts could refuse after their marker; template split.
Gate did not re-derive the one fit point from the registered fit role.
Crash windows between a write and its sidecar or marker.
prepare_attempt had no capture-ready or phase-complete state.
live-inputs copies were not checked against their committed archives.

reviewers: independent re-review 1 of the pre-seal fix waves
independent re-review 2 of the pre-seal fix waves

findings.summary: Owner intrinsic-record content was first checked after the analysis marker; the frozen engine now reads it at the gate's creation.
An L1 named growth miss graded PASS; named owner verdicts now pass only on an existing record.
Stale-lock release raced a second dispatcher's fresh lease; one sidecar flock.
Pre-fit evidence was not bound to the rebuilt proofs; prefit_lineage.
Creation-time owner admission ran outside the quarantine; lexical declaration compare; owner output files absent; check_native_not_ready.
native.complete.json pinned more than the quarantined payload.
Torn raw capture writes wedged reconciliation; the helper evaluator read the sealed native path.
The r2 owner-recovery witness admitted any sha256 on a moved pin and skipped two links.
An empty analytical cut raised after the native marker instead of a checkpointed stop; readiness docstring.
Owner self-check witness pinned a stale grader.
